summary.text: Paul Melotik is a Republican member of the Wisconsin State Assembly from District 22 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election, where Democrat Dana Glasstein is also on the ballot.

paragraphs.text: Paul Melotik graduated from West Allis Nathan Hale High School in 1975 and earned a B.S. in accounting and business management from Carroll College Waukesha in 1979.

His career includes co-owning and operating Flannery's Bar/Restaurant Milwaukee and Fire Ridge Golf Course, and working as an accountant with Wisconsin Electric, an athletic director and a basketball coach.
Melotik has served on the Ozaukee County Board of Supervisors.
Melotik won the July 18, 2023 special general election for Wisconsin State Assembly District 24, defeating Democrat Bob Tatterson.
In the November 5, 2024 general election he defeated Dana Glasstein for the District 22 seat, 58.0 percent to 41.9 percent.
For 2025-2026 his committee assignments include chairing the Workforce Development Committee and serving as vice-chair of the Forestry, Parks, and Outdoor Recreation Committee.
